propositions: Git probes in repo-isolation session hooks (head and porcelain) invoked subprocess.run with no timeout, allowing blocked Git processes to keep pytest alive indefinitely after test completion.

Test monkeypatches of the shared subprocess module's run attribute were dereferenced before pytest restored them, causing the autouse repo guard to invoke test-double subprocess stubs and trigger false TimeoutExpired exceptions during teardown.

The fix binds the real subprocess.run at module import as _run_process and routes both probes through that stable callable, preventing later monkeypatches from contaminating the isolation guard while preserving the five-second timeout and explicit timeout failure semantics.
TimeoutExpired must be re-raised explicitly as an isolation-infrastructure failure to distinguish hung Git processes from ordinary probe failures, which continue returning None.
